content:
Starting today, iPhone users with the Suno app installed can generate songs directly within the Messages app using text or voice prompts. Here are the details.

Suno brings song generation to iMessage

Suno is one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, boasting over 2 million paid subscribers and generating 7 million songs per day.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also offers an iPhone app that allows users to create and remix AI songs via text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. The app features playlists of user-generated songs, editorial picks, and genre-categorized playlists.

Now, Suno users can create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. Once the Suno app is installed, it will appear in the Messages app drawer alongside other iMessage apps, letting users generate songs with text prompts or voice memos without leaving the conversation.

Here's a demo of the feature in action:

Suno says users can pick a genre before generating a song, and also regenerate to explore different versions before sending to the conversation.

One potential limitation: Suno notes that both users need to have the app installed to use the feature. But for anyone who enjoys AI song creation, downloading the free app shouldn't be much of a hurdle.

Download Suno from the App Store now.
